content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks nigeria

Stripe, a multinational payment processor, offers seamless payment processing for businesses, but its restrictions in Nigeria mean that creators are left out. PayPal, on the other hand, provides payment services, but its inconsistent policies and fees make it unreliable. Gumroad, a platform for creators, offers a simple way to sell digital products, but its restrictions in Nigeria mean that creators have to look for alternatives. NOWPayments, a sovereign payment processor, offers a wide range of cryptocurrencies and zero fees for sender, making it an attractive option for creators in restricted countries.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in 46 countries out of 195 on earth, leaving a significant number of countries, including Nigeria, without access to its services. PayPal's inconsistent policies and fees make it unpredictable, and its account suspension can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. Gumroad's restrictions in Nigeria mean that creators have to look for alternatives. NOWPayments, on the other hand, offers sovereignty and infrastructure independence, making it a reliable option for creators in restricted countries.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe charges a 2.9% + 30¢ processing fee, while PayPal charges 2.9% + 30¢ for domestic transactions and 4.4% + 30¢ for international transactions. Gumroad charges a 3.5% + 30¢ fee for digital products. NOWPayments, on the other hand, charges a flat 0.5% fee for sender, making it an attractive option for creators who want to keep their costs low.
Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195 on earth, leaving many countries without access to its services.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Stripe and PayPal require creators to transfer ownership of their products to their platforms, giving them control over the sales process. Gumroad also requires creators to transfer ownership of their products. NOWPayments, on the other hand, allows creators to keep ownership of their products and automates the payment process, making it a more reliable option for creators who value sovereignty and independence.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
